description: How to write and send transactional emails (welcome, first-deploy, notifications) from Cloudflare Workers. Covers the preferred personal writing style (no headings, Gmail-default look, dark mode), building HTML with plain template strings, the send_email wrangler binding, previewing in light/dark mode with Playwriter, test-sending real emails via a temp worker without deploying, and one-off scripts that email specific users via the cloudflare SDK (plan changes, bug notices). ALWAYS load this skill when adding, editing, testing, or sending transactional emails in a project.
